rationale: Kept nominal PD+I core but added latched large-delay detector and gain/slew scheduling. Nominal mode keeps v4-like Kp~0.7/Ki~0.06/Kd~0.8 with 6s lead. When error stays large while filtered rate stays ~0 and initial lift fails, latch delay=1: switch to Kp=0.18/Ki=0.012/Kd=0, no lead, Tf 6s/Tr 8s, s_max top 0.75, slew 0.04/0.06 per s, tighter uff limits and one-time fast cut to <=0.65 on transition. This removes 24s-delay oscillation while preserving nominal acquisition.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir, target 0.6 band 0.55-0.65. Pre-change: lag 2-4s, hold ~0.6, gain ~1. Post-change: pure transport delay ~22-26s (~24s) with similar gain/drain. Controller must be dual-mode: aggressive when response <10s, ultra-conservative latched mode when flat.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal episodes: in-band 1.0 after 30s, MAE ~0.01, energy ~48-50, zero overrides as v4. Delayed 24s episodes: stable, zero hard violations/invalid, overrides ~0, no sustained oscillation; MAE well below degraded 0.136 and below v4 post-change 0.115, slow convergence toward band from feedforward ~0.6 plus tiny trim, initial overshoot limited by 0.65 cut on detection.
extra.diagnosis: Transport delay increased from 2-4s to ~24s, not gain/drain/sensor. E13 u=0 for 40s: y held ~0.40-0.43 for 15s then ROSE to 0.48 while u=0 (prior u~0.75 still in transit) then fell sharply only after ~231s (~26s after switch). E14 u=0.8 for 8s from 245.3 produced no rise during pulse, y kept falling 0.13 to 0.02. E15 u=0 hold: flat ~0.0 until ~269.4 then hump 0.0 to 0.15 lasting ~8s, i.e. 24.1s after E14 start (245.3) and 16s after E14 end. Magnitude preserved (~0.13 rise for 0.8 pulse consistent with pre-change gain) and u=0 decay rate once started similar, ruling out weaker actuator/faster outflow. Monitoring after_change also shows y stuck ~0.68 for 20s while u~0.44 before falling, classic dead-time.
